scope: Independent saved STEP mass-property remeasurement and contract aggregation; preserved geometry inputs, declared joint frames, motor body membership, positive inertias and frozen evidence. Complete mating-bore/pin alignment and assembly feasibility are not established. No whole-range collision, cable-routing validation, motor calibration or hardware performance approval.

command_contract_review.scope: Independent command reconstruction from committed endpoints/times, exact full-rate projection-loss arithmetic, and rounded display-trace consistency. Decimated actual angles do not revalidate fine-rate events or sustained settling.

small_motion_numerical_evidence.criterion: Both maximum angle difference<=0.02deg and all hold-quality statuses identical; fixed before run

model_test_evidence_review.scope: Freshness and stated-threshold consistency of producer test results; tests are not rerun by this reviewer.

thumb_diagnostic_review.scope: Independent full-rate axis17 command/held-controller/PWM/torque/power/limiter arithmetic and reported aggregate checks. No new trajectory integration, coupled damping optimum, physical actuator or hardware-performance approval.

simulation_report_review.scope: Checks committed event arithmetic/coverage and CAD-to-simulation data consistency; does not independently replay or calibrate the dynamics engine.

compiled_model_frame_review.scope: Independent CAD parent-frame/axis composition versus compiled MuJoCo model at neutral and 12 non-neutral poses; includes body COM and rotated inertia, not integrated trajectory or physical calibration.

actual_parent_bore_review.scope: Saved STEP parent/child cylindrical bores and shaft nominal axes near distal hinge anchors at neutral pose only. Agreement within0.1deg/0.001mm is a numerical geometry check, not manufacturing tolerance approval. Aligned does not validate bearing fits, pin retention, horn coupling, swept clearance or assembly feasibility.

physical_assembly_envelope_review.scope: Saved physical STEP solids at neutral pose, exact-surface bounds without triangulation, including motor rotors; cable envelopes excluded. This is an assembly envelope, not a swept volume, attachment proof or manufacturing release.

palm_motor_mounting_review.scope: Saved STEP axis, axial envelope, fastener-head direction, nominal seating-area and narrow thread-intrusion checks. Eight adapter-to-chassis connections remain absent; no supported-foot, structural, thread-strength, tool-access or physical-performance approval.

mechanical_blocker_list_scope: The legacy field above lists nominal hinge-axis defects only; an empty list is not construction approval.
unresolved_construction_scope: Rigid motor-to-body attachment is a dynamics assumption; new raised or rotated motor plates require physical supports, fasteners and verified load paths.
Nominal bore and pin axes do not establish fits, retention, horn engagement, structural strength or access for assembly.
Continuous swept clearance and functional tendon routing, wraps, tensioners and terminals remain unvalidated.

sampled_mount_sweep_review.generation_rule: Neutral pose then 12 NumPy default_rng uniform fractions [.15,.85) of each declared joint range, in joint_names order.
sampled_mount_sweep_review.scope: Saved STEP fixed cradle/adapter/fastener vs moving physical body components at 13 declared poses. Conservative transformed AABB broadphase then exact intersections; no mating exclusions in this cross-body set. Not continuous sweep, self-collision of all moving bodies, support strength, tool access or fabrication approval.
